notes.title: UPDATE #5 - Gameplay and Matchmaking Improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152909/7baf15b85154daf6bddac5c0b4430cc2a085dd18.jpg[/img]

          We have updated the latest patch with a couple of upgrades in features and bug fixes. We would like to thank everyone for the support and feedback provided. Hope to see you all in the game. Have fun heisting.

[u][b]FUNCTIONALITY[/b][/u]

[b]          SPRINT TOGGLE[/b]
[list][*]                      Toggling sprint option added in settings [/list]

[u][b]BUG FIX[/b][/u]

[b]          SNIPER FIX[/b]
                     [list][*]Sniper bullet damage dealt on body and head was same - FIXED[/list]
                     [list][*]Sniper Headshot UI not visible- FIXED[/list]
                     [list][*]Crouch + Sprint to slide through the map fixed[/list]
[b]          BACKGROUND MUSIC[/b]
                     [list][*]Background Music repeating bug fixed[/list]

[u][b]MATCHMAKING[/b][/u]

                    Security deposit of 5000 cash in lobby to prevent quiting while in lobby for 10 mins. If you are not able to find a match, the cash gets refunded to your account. 
                    Lobby notification when new player joins the match
                    Minimum 8 players to start the match. The system asks whether to play GangWar with 8 players or wait for 2 more players to play Heist.
                    Timer reset causing players to spawn twice fixed
                    Spectate camera improvised in lobby, F4 to switch camera

[u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u]

[b]          JUMP FIX[/b]
                     [list][*]Jump damage added if fallen from a certain height[/list]
                     [list][*]Double/triple Jump Damage faced due to high ping solved[/list]

notes.title: Update 083001 - Matchmaking and Major Improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152909/460c044c578c3a16e487b8b4ae524d9e432ee7af.png[/img]
          Our latest update is live. We had a minor setback and took some extra time but we give you the biggest update after Early Access Release. We have changed the matchmaking system completely, with a whole new map and some bug fixes.

[b][u]FUNCTIONALITY[/u][/b]
[b]          BULLET DROP[/b]
                     Sniper Bullet trajectory is now dependent on Distance, Speed and Gravity.
[b]          CONTROLS[/b]
                     Key Remapping added for switching 'Equip HandGun' and 'Next Track'

[b][u]BUG FIX[/u][/b]
[b]          SUPPORT CLASS WEAPON SWITCH[/b]
                     Now switching from Tazor to Handgun will not duplicate tazor bullet count on handgun

[b][u]MATCHMAKING[/u][/b]
                     Now all players will join an automated matchmaking, which uses a back-filling ticketing system to match any 12 players from the region on first come basis. With the new Matchmaking System, players will join into the lobby heist game mode with 1 minute cashout round system and 1 random weapon per round.

[b][u]GAMEPLAY[/u][/b]
[b]          FPS CAP INCREASED TO 75[/b]
                     As a constant process of optimization & improving the game performance, We have increased the max FPS limit to 75. 
[b]          CROUCH[/b]
                     Delay added between two consecutive crouches removing crouch spam. Crouch camera movement made smooth, removing camera flicker.

notes.title: Update 082501 - Matchmaking and Major Improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152909/7baf15b85154daf6bddac5c0b4430cc2a085dd18.jpg[/img]

[b]We have just uploaded a Major Update in our Matchmaking System which will help in finding matches faster. We have also added multiple bug fixes and improvements. Details mentioned below.[/b]

[u][b]FUNCTIONALITY[/b][/u]
[b]FOV SLIDER[/b]
[list]
[*] Field of View(FOV) slider added under VIDEO category in SETTINGS menu to change FOV within a certain defined range as per the design choices.
[/list]
[u][b]BUG FIX[/b][/u]
[b]Gameplay HUD Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] HUD sometimes disappear on death due to server lag issue.
[/list]

[u][b]MATCHMAKING[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Matchfinding Alogirthm modified. On click play, player will be matched with any 11 players in the same server. After successfully joining a server, Players can now vote for the game mode of their choice.
[/list]

[u][b]INVITE FRIENDS[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Party limit increased to 6. Bug Fixes in inviting friends, kicking them and finding match as a party
[/list]

[u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u]
[b]1. Weapon System[/b]
[list]a) MK18 Balanced [/list]
[list]
[*] Damage increased
[*] Damage coefficiuency tweaked
[*] Vertical and horizontal recoil value increased
[/list]
[list]b) AKL Nurf [/list]
[list]
[*] Vertical Recoil increased
[*] Damage reduced
[*] Damage coefficiuency tweaked
[/list]
[list]c) Desi katta Buff [/list]
[list]
[*] Desi katta damage increased.
[*] Bullet trail speed reduced
[/list]
2. SPAWN PROTECTION
[list]
[*] Spawn protection improvised. Character movement, Jump or Firing disables spawn protection. Crouch and camera movement won't affect it.
[/list]
3. SHOULDER SWAP
[list]
[*] Hint in UI for Shoulder Swap. Shoulder Swap default key binding changed to C
[/list]
4. Friendly Fire Disabled

notes.title: Version 082104 - Patch Notes and Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152909/7baf15b85154daf6bddac5c0b4430cc2a085dd18.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]
We would like to thank everyone for the feedback and support. We have been constantly in development and have updated some of the major issues and have added a new campaign in our game. FIXING ROGUE HEIST. You can leave your reviews and bug reports inside the game. We will constantly keep updating and developing according to the feedback from all of you. 

Here is the list of some of the issues we have solved and features added.


[b]Gameplay[/b]
-Shoulder swap updated with improved and smoother camera movement
-Added X mark to represent whether collision ahead while shooting fixing the issue of shooting through obstacles when crosshair not blocked. 
-Scope view zoom in location changed from crosshair to Sniperscope which avoids hiding behind obstacle and shooting. Also prevented scope zoom through obstacles.

[b]UI[/b]
-FIXING ROGUE HEIST CAMPAIGN added
-Patch notes and WIP page added

[b]Functionality[/b]
-GangWar additional spawn points added

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
-Hacking Flow fixed where you cannot hack and dual package appears

[b]Matchmaking[/b]
-Joining in same team as a party instead of joining randomly even when in a party

notes.title: Beta 4 Patch Notes and Updates
notes.content:
Hey Heisters,

With our current Beta we have gathered lot of bug-reports and suggestions. As we are committed to involve community in every beta to get the real feedback, here is the list of issues and features added.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon switch animation added giving delay to weapon switch and fixed continuous firing of two guns 
[*] Game end fixed
[*] Grenade throw animation and Arc added
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Hint Notification when any player enters the hacking zone... about what is happening or what to do
[*] Push to Talk Icon will near on Teammate HUD Item
[*] Markers on Screen for Point of Interest with Dynamic colour, distance and system
[/list]

[b]Functionality[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Notify if Input Key Binding is already in use for some other action
[*] Spawn Protection and occasional invincibility fixed
[/list]


[b]Matchmaking[/b]
[list]
[*] 6v6 matchmaking with automatic side selection with timer and certain bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Shotgun, bolt action time gap, if anyone presses left click to fire, it starts to reload - FIXED
[*] If got out of being tazed, suppose assault throws a grenade at you after getting out of being tazed, instead of dying, you get tazed again
[*] Every character changes direction when package deposited in the team car
[*] While hacking - you can shoot
[*] While hacking - deploy shield while hacking animation, character movement gets back to normal and if you are in the region, you can continue the hacking.
[*] While hacking, if someone disables your beacon and starts hacking, does not show your hacking failed. Instead lets you finish hacking makes the character stuck in the hackling loop and only can be fixed by starting hacking again and cancelling it. Also, the jump gets blocked.
You can throw grenades while being tased
throw grenade after death
[*] Players can empty magazine and get infinite bullets by pressing 1 and 2 together
[*] Shield jumps off if near a collision and deployed
[*] When gets shot, direction indicator UI which shows where the bullet came from was not correct
[*] Even after death, scope remains till the kill cam comes up. so you wouldn’t know whether you die or not
[*] In rare cases scope stays behind and won't go off. even after death or even after switching classes it stays
[*] Switch weapons while hacking. lets you shoot
[*] Character movement restriction at game end
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon sounds remastered
[*] Gameplay background music added
[/list]

Thank you all for your patience and support whilst we address known bugs and completing the features list as per our year-long roadmap.

notes.title: Beta 3 Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

We would like to thank you guys because yesterday's beta went fantastically well. For all the enthusiasm you showed for the game whether that's participating in the beta itself, waiting for matches patiently, reporting bugs, giving feedbacks and suggestions; we can't appreciate the support we are getting enough.

Following is the list of bugs further solved 

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gang War Winning Counts till 100
[*] AKL And Vector Recoil Updated
[*] Sniper Jump Height increased Support ADS Speed Increased
[*] MP7 Recoil Updated
[*] Removed F for all classes except Support
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gang War Text in Finding Game
[/list]

[h1]Functionality[/h1]
[list]
[*] Restore to default on Sensitivity setting [UPDATED]
[*] Master Volume - from "1" to "0.5" [Default Settings changed]
[*] General Sensitivity - from "1" to "0.5" [Default Settings changed]
[*] ADS Sensitivity - from "1" to "0.5" [Default Settings changed]
[/list]

[h1]MatchMaking[/h1]
[list]
[*] Toggle ready removed. Automatic game start at 60 sec.
[*] Players count in Lobby menu
[*] Lobby will show current matchmaking game mode (5v5) or (6v6)

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Throw grenade after death - Fixed
[/list]

[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list]
[*] New M18 Shooting Cue Sound Added and Updated on BP
[*] Frag grenade sound decreased
[*] RNG Map Reverb Audio FX decay value decreased from 3 to 1.
[*] [GangWar] Added Ambient SFX in GW_Startup Level
[/list]

We'll keep you guys updated about the beta coming up in the next week. For more info and updates, you can join Rogue Heist on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/ZnzEUxx]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Beta 2 Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

Beta 2 is live, we are testing one of the TDM mode (GANG WAR) today. Among various bug fixes done for the bugs reported, PUSH TO TALK is the most significant feature added. Now players can communicate better. 

Following is the list of patch notes that have been done till date. We thank you for showing patience and sending in suggestions and feedbacks constantly. Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ZnzEUxx]DISCORD[/url] for more info and updates.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character Physics updated in Crow
[*] Camera shake updated for all weapons
[*] Reload time changed for AKL and M18
[*] Recoil for MP7 changed
[*] Damage of Dessi Katta increased
[*] Game Settings Page Updated
[/list]


[h1]Animation[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character shoot animation updated(while crouching and jog)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] AutoShoot when another player reloads - Fixed
[*] Repeated reloading by multiple left clicks - Fixed
[*] Multiple reload using R causing the character to lose the ability to reload without finishing the mag - Fixed
[*] With full mag, pressing R causes the character to lose the ability to reload - Fixed
[*] Change in character speed from sprint to jog after getting out of the shoot, reload, jump and crouch even when holding shift - Fixed
[*] Shooting while too close to anyone doesn't kill them - Fixed
[*] ESC button has to be pressed twice to go to settings and can't go out of it with ESC -Fixed
[*] Tab Button Error for showing the players - Fixed
[*] Backend weapon data updated based on the class
[*] Interact Key Binding - Fixed
[/list]

[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list]
[*] Volume updated for Guns
[*] Sound Added for Grenades
[*] Environment sound added
[*] Sniper Volume reduced
[*] Reverb added in maps
[*] Attenuation added for Taser gun
[/list]

We will be hosting constant betas to make the experience smooth at the time of launch. Give us a shoutout, spread a word about Rogue Heist. See you in the game.

notes.title: Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're happy to announce that the Rogue Heist Pre-Order has begun. Starting from Friday, June 14th to Monday June 17th; this Beta is exclusively for Pre-Order buyers and Gleam giveaway winners.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152909/709f0be157a940f1b6b81efb08f4d5dc3e5fc4c3.jpg[/img]

While access to this beta is restricted, we thought we'd let you know it's happening as the chances are you'll be seeing new gameplay related posts here on Steam, as well as footage from the beta on YouTube and various streaming platforms. 

This beta will feature the following things: 

[list]
[*] A completely revamped Heist Mode 
[*] Improved graphics 
[*] Two new classes joining Sniper & Assault:
[*] Hacker 
[*] Support 
[*] New weapons system, now each class has their own weapon choices 
[*] Two new game modes: Run 'n' Gun & Gangwar
Sounds - Updated weapon sounds (Work in progress)
[/list]

We are also giving beta keys as giveaways through gleam. Check out the following link to win a chance to enter Closed beta of Rogue Heist. 

[url=https://www.rogueheist.com/#pre-order]Pre-Order Rogue Heist [/url]
[url=https://gleam.io/ASJS4/rogue-heist-closed-beta-key-giveaway]Gleam Giveaways[/url]

Join our discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/ZnzEUxx]Discord[/url]
